summary.text: Stacey Pheffer Amato has represented the 23rd Assembly District in Queens, which includes Ozone Park, Howard Beach, Broad Channel, Breezy Point and the Rockaway Peninsula, since 2017.
Her official biography says she chairs the Governmental Employees Committee, only the second woman to hold that role.

paragraphs.text: According to her Assembly biography, Pheffer Amato's mother, Queens County Clerk Audrey I. Pheffer, held the same Assembly seat for over 25 years.
Upon her election they became the first mother-daughter team elected to the State Legislature in New York history, the biography says.
She also serves on the Education, Veterans' Affairs, Corporations, Authorities and Commissions, and Racing and Wagering Committees.

The biography says she has passed over twenty pieces of legislation, often with bipartisan support, on subjects including women's health, rights of the disabled and elderly, veterans and 9/11 first responders, Jamaica Bay and swim safety.
She lives in Rockaway Beach with her husband, Frank, and their two children.
